title: 义务教育教科书·英语（湘少版）三年级下册

sentences.en: How are you? I am fine, thank you.

sentences.cn: 这个男孩和这个女孩是我的好朋友。
sentences.en: The boy and the girl are my good friends.

sentences.cn: 这位男士是我爸爸，这位女士是我妈妈。
sentences.en: The man is my father, and the woman is my mother.
Please come to school at eight.
I read at night and play in the day.
It is rainy and cold today.

sentences.cn: 我喜欢这件T恤和这条长裤。
sentences.en: I like this T-shirt and these trousers.

sentences.cn: 戴上帽子，穿上衬衫和裙子。
sentences.en: Put on your cap, your shirt and your skirt.

sentences.cn: 这双鞋很好看，我喜欢它们。
sentences.en: These shoes are nice, and I like them.
There are thirteen birds in the tree.

sentences.cn: 我有十四个苹果和十五个梨。
sentences.en: I have fourteen apples and fifteen pears.

sentences.cn: 那儿有十六只、十七只和十八只风筝。
sentences.en: There are sixteen, seventeen and eighteen kites.
Twenty children are in the park.
There is a big potato here.

sentences.cn: 这儿有很多鸡蛋、西红柿和胡萝卜。
sentences.en: There are many eggs, tomatoes and carrots.

sentences.cn: 好的，洗洗你的胳膊和脖子。
sentences.en: OK, wash your arm and your neck.
We play games on Children’s Day.

sentences.cn: 每个孩子都喜欢画画和涂色。
sentences.en: Every child likes to draw and paint.
We watch a show at the party.
I go to school by bus.
I go to my hometown by ship.

sentences.cn: 我坐火车上学，我爸爸开车去。
sentences.en: I go to school by train, and my father goes by car.

sentences.cn: 我们可以坐出租车、坐飞机或者骑自行车去。
sentences.en: We can go by taxi, by plane or by bike.

sentences.cn: 欢迎来到我们的食品厂！
那位男士是我们的老师。
那位女士也是我们的老师。
sentences.en: The woman is our teacher, too.

sentences.cn: 我爸爸是司机，我妈妈是护士。
sentences.en: My father is a driver and my mother is a nurse.

sentences.cn: 农民、工人和医生都在这儿。
sentences.en: The farmer, the worker and the doctor are here.
